gloss: to insert; to plug in; to shine in

definitions.explanation: To put something into a slot, socket, or opening.

definitions.gloss: to shine in; to stream in
definitions.explanation: For light to come in through an opening, especially sunlight through a window.

examples.japanese: コンセントにプラグを{差|さ}し{込|こ}んでください。
examples.english: Please plug the plug into the outlet.

examples.japanese: {窓|まど}から{朝日|あさひ}が{差|さ}し{込|こ}んでいた。
examples.english: Morning sunlight was streaming in through the window.

examples.japanese: カードを{差|さ}し{込|こ}んでパスワードを{入力|にゅうりょく}してください。
examples.english: Insert your card and enter your password.

notes:
{差|さ}し{込|こ}む has both transitive and intransitive uses depending on the meaning.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Sense 1 (insert): transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
- Sense 2 (shine in): intransitive ({自動詞|じどうし})

ASPECT (ている):
- {差|さ}し{込|こ}んでいる (plugged in): something remains inserted
- {差|さ}し{込|こ}んでいる (light): light is streaming in continuously

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- [thing]を[slot]に{差|さ}し{込|こ}む — to insert [thing] into [slot]
- [light]が{差|さ}し{込|こ}む — [light] shines in

COMMON PATTERNS:
- プラグを{差|さ}し{込|こ}む (plug in)
- {鍵|かぎ}を{差|さ}し{込|こ}む (insert a key)
- {光|ひかり}が{差|さ}し{込|こ}む (light streams in)
- {木漏|こも}れ{日|び}が{差|さ}し{込|こ}む (sunlight filtering through trees)

RELATED WORDS:
- {差|さ}し{込|こ}み{口|ぐち}: outlet, socket
- コンセント: electrical outlet (from "concentric plug")
